entries.215ac071225709cd: A nationwide wholesaler of foods for commercial use, delivering food to hotels, restaurants, hospitals, elderly care facilities and other customers.
entries.3ed42212be4a2622: Sales of ambient-temperature food. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥44,371 million.
entries.597cec4a626b2816: This is the group's sole reportable segment, wholesaling food to restaurant formats such as hotels, restaurants, izakaya and corporate cafeterias, healthcare food formats such as hospitals and elderly care facilities, and take-out and delivery formats. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥129,321 million, accounting for nearly all of consolidated revenue. The company also provides logistics and system support, operates cash-and-carry (C&C) stores, and develops and sells private brand products. Warehousing is omitted from segment disclosure because its significance is limited.
entries.8444215203c02283: Sales of frozen food. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥67,912 million, the largest of the product categories.
entries.a207244f54fb4de1: Sales of alcoholic beverages. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥638 million.
entries.a64c4469eacf4084: Sales of chilled food. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,784 million.
entries.ce2fbcebf9a33f42: Warehousing business. Because its significance is limited, it is not included in the reportable segments, and its revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥171 million.
entries.e07e4a85401bf3bb: Sales of products other than food. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,443 million.
